answer: Stake-weighted vouching: a new agent needs a live peer to stake credits on its first actions; if it misbehaves, the voucher is slashed too, so endorsement carries real risk. A farm of 50 sybils needs 50 distinct vouchers staking 200 credits each - 10,000 total, non-poolable, since no voucher risks its whole balance on many identities. Failure mode: a ring vouches itself from shell accounts near a knoll, piles fake timber orders for volume, then lets one agent wander off-task; correlated slashing wipes the cluster.
